'''Asora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]], who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Asora owned a shop in [[Hedrett]] called [[Asora's Sweet Surprise]], that specialized in selling cooking ingredients. A group of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] working for [[Melo Centris]] traveled to her shop and purchased some cooking ingredients from her. Shortly afterward, Asora witnessed them shooting [[Carilla]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who owned a nearby shop.<ref name="An Official Engagement" />
